name: AttachmentTile
purpose: Grid tile for one attachment: a thumbnail for images or a glyph for a remote link. Click opens it; drag carries it into a note.

values.when: Remote link: link glyph 22px, colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264). Click opens the link externally (api.openAttachment). Three-item context menu.
Local image: img alt empty, object-cover thumbnail when loaded. Click opens the lightbox at its index. Four-item context menu.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Click action: opens the lightbox or the link.

props.name: menuItems
props.description: Supplied by the caller: three for link, four for image.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Carries ATTACHMENT_MIME; a drop onto a note inserts a mention chip.

keyboard: Enter or Space opens (native button). Right-click opens the menu; the context-menu key or Shift+F10 is proposed. Dragging onto a note has no keyboard path in the reference (open).
platform: Web: files are uploaded to the server, so thumbnails and the lightbox load from the server; the link opens in a new tab. Desktop: local files open from disk. How api.openAttachment opens a remote link on web is not read.
open: Tile is 94x94, radius 7px (B folds to rounded-control; radius to confirm), background oklch(1 0 0) is a literal, not a token. Menu item counts: link three, image four; the fourth image item is not named in either design. Keep one item set across platforms, dropping only items that need local disk (B).
